family: Two closed nondegenerate rational triangles in world R3, each with fixed orientation/shape and constant rational translation velocity times a shared t in one bounded closed rational interval. Optional fixed endpoint is a point primitive. Pair intervals only; not an inferred union, not a full network, not a source converter.
alternative: For this rigid-translation subfamily, use exact separating-axis projection rather than floating LP as a proposal generator. This does not subsume the general affine half-space route. Independent reference is bounded barycentric linear feasibility with all vertices enumerated exactly; no shared contact logic.
primary: Every declared analytic pair window (empty, point, or interval including endpoints) equals both expected rational answer and independent vertex projection; false claimed endpoints, empty window and stale model must be rejected. No speed or novelty claim.
exclusions: generated triangulations, unknown holes or identities
no real adaptation until product-source gate
baseline: Independent exact Cramer/Gauss vertex enumeration from barycentric equality and nonnegative weights, not a sampling grid. AABB only as a knowingly insufficient diagnostic.
trigger: First-round T3 analytic cut only after kernel_r3/kernel_qualification.json grants offline qualification; new geometry is not automatically integrated with its solver or checker.
